workflow: Transcribing order details from email confirmations into an Excel spreadsheet, then manually uploading the spreadsheet into the CRM system.
trigger: Whenever a customer places an order via email or web form
current_workaround: Using Excel formulas and VBA macros to pre-format data before import into CRM
consequence: Data entry errors cause incorrect shipments, order delays, and time lost on cleanup

workflow: Downloading bank statements, manually matching each transaction to invoices in the ERP, and reconciling differences.
current_workaround: Using Excel pivot tables and VLOOKUP formulas to speed up the matching
consequence: Missed discrepancies can lead to unrecorded bank fees or duplicate payments, and close is delayed

workflow: Remotely logging into hundreds of servers to apply critical security patches, reboot, and verify services.
trigger: Monthly Patch Tuesday or urgent out-of-band updates
current_workaround: Writing custom Bash scripts that use SSH and for loops to patch a subset of servers at a time
consequence: Servers remain vulnerable if patches are not applied quickly; patch verification is often skipped

workflow: Maintaining a homegrown ETL script that parses client-supplied Excel/CSV files and imports them into the warehouse, with frequent manual fixes when files change format.
trigger: Each new client file arrives or when source format changes
current_workaround: Keeping a set of disposable Python scripts and manual console commands to handle edge cases
consequence: Broken scripts cause data quality issues and require urgent engineer attention instead of planned work

workflow: Maintaining a master Excel workbook to track completion of mandatory compliance courses, updating rows from LMS export files and sending individual reminder emails to overdue employees.
trigger: Quarterly compliance audit or onboarding of new employees
current_workaround: Using conditional formatting and pivot tables to highlight overdue training, then copying email addresses manually
consequence: Could miss training deadlines for some employees, resulting in regulatory fines or audit findings
